Channel branding

The banner is cropped differently on every device — TV gets the whole 2560 × 1440, mobile gets only the centre 1546 × 423. So every word and mark lives inside that box, and everything outside it is texture that has to be able to disappear. Turn on Guides in the header to see both crops.
